question: Chemical formula for the marble is _________
solution:
The correct answer is __CaCO₃__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Explanation:__

__
 
• The chemical name of marble is calcium carbonate. 
 
• It has the chemical formula CaCO₃ and is an inorganic chemical compound.

Ca(OH)₂ (aq) + CO₂ (g) → CaCO₃ (s) + H₂O (*l*)

 
• Calcium hydroxide slowly reacts with the carbon dioxide (CO₂) in the air to form a thin layer of calcium carbonate on the walls. 
 
• Calcium carbonate is formed after two to three days of whitewashing and gives a shiny finish to the walls.
 
• Calcium carbonate is a non-toxic, odorless chemical compound that occurs naturally as a white mineral in marbles, limestones, and chalks.
 
• It is one of the most abundant minerals found in the crust of the earth.

Thus, the chemical formula of marble is CaCO3.__
